title: Some basics and details for better dual-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2686-2719
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04063E, Review Article
Wenhao Xu, Libo Li, Yangmingyue Zhao, Suo Li, Hang Yang, Hao Tong, Zhixuan Wang
Our work provides an overview of dual-ion batteries, focusing on interface engineering and stable electrolytes. We emphasize the potential of CEI and electrolyte design for DIB technology's application in safety and performance.
